images.title: Inside, same side adds to 180
images.purpose: Show angles 3 and 6 between the parallel lines on the same side of t, 50° and 130°, adding to 180°.
images.composition: Parallel lines and a transversal centred; the two interior angles are the only filled angles; sum caption at the bottom.
exact_structure: Two horizontal parallel lines, l above and m below, each with two small arrow marks (>>) at the right end.
A transversal t going down to the right, crossing l and m.
Angle 3: at the crossing with l, lower right angle (between the lines, on the right of t), filled teal (#0072B2), labelled 3 and 50°.
Angle 6: at the crossing with m, upper right angle (between the lines, on the right of t), filled amber (#E69F00), labelled 6 and 130°.
The two filled angles are on the same side of t and both lie between l and m.
One caption line below the figure showing the sum.
rejection: either filled angle outside the two lines
images.takeaway: Interior angles on the same side of the transversal add to 180°.
images.description: Parallel lines with the interior angles 3 = 50° and 6 = 130° on the same side of the transversal.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Students see both angles inside the lines on one side and add them.

image_decisions.why: Showing only the two interior angles keeps the idea clear.
